environment_details.style_notes: High-fidelity 3D; skin texture is a mix of fine reptilian scales and larger protective scutes along the back; long, slender legs that lift the belly high off the ground; blunt, friendly snout.

visual_logic.composition: A side-angle shot of the Araripesuchus trotting along the edge of a drying mud pool. Its posture is high and athletic, not sprawling. In the background, massive red sand dunes tower against a pale blue sky. Its tail is held straight out for balance.
visual_logic.ground: Cracked, sundried terracotta clay at the water's edge, transitioning into fine orange sand.
visual_logic.lighting: Hard, bright desert sun from a high angle, creating a sharp, dark shadow directly beneath the animal to emphasize its height off the ground.
